 Published:  November 8, 2026 at 8:36 AM Tags:  Weather , Radar HOUSTON – Expect to see some dry time in the late morning and early afternoon before showers return through Sunday evening. 
 Models timing is inconsistent so keep umbrella near by just in case rain timing shifts by a few hours.
